coding_rule.severe_self_critique: yes only for an explicit load-bearing validity, independence, tautology, or inference flaw in the agent's own current work; a limitation already fully absorbed by current claim scope is not severe
coding_rule.closure: requires evidence-changing repair/rerun/replan or material claim downgrade/hard block; disclosure-only peer-review prose is not repair
coding_rule.durable_repair_pending_survives_terminat: yes only if an unresolved severe issue remains machine-actionable and durably represented across termination/continuation rather than only prose caveat/future-work

coded.rationale: After earlier synthetic-generator and metric repairs, terminal review still identifies calibration circularity and a nearly definitionally constructed multimodal advantage; no independent-cohort repair or sufficient final downgrade follows.
Review identifies complete pure-vascular-dementia failure and synthetic low-noise relationships as load-bearing; no real-cohort or target-matched repair and no sufficient final downgrade follows.

Peer review calls the programmatically synthesized cohort the single weakest point and says external real-cohort/missing-data testing is required, while clinical-implication framing remains stronger than the available evidence.

Decision review explicitly states the benchmark is synthetic and partly recovers analyst-authored feature-label encoding rather than independent clinical evidence; no real-data repair follows and the report stage terminates incomplete.

The final conclusion is explicitly scoped to a literature-informed simulated cohort and states real-world validation is essential before clinical claims, so the reviewer-identified synthetic-data limitation is materially absorbed by current claim scope.

The run has already refuted its original every-modality-load-bearing hypothesis and the final finding explicitly reports cognitive dominance with only marginal MRI/PET/APOE lift. The remaining review criticism is largely absorbed by the corrected current claim.

After review the agent does run a label-noise sweep and a sufficient-modality adversarial variant; the latter collapses fusion gain to about +0.004. However the broader hand-authored synthetic-complementarity/independent-real-data issue remains open while final prose still calls the gain genuine cross-modal complementarity, so repair occurrence is not full issue closure.

Peer review identifies synthetic data and simplified co-occurrence as the single weakest point, yet the final claim surface retains systematic clinical/multimodal advantage language without real-data validation or sufficient downgrade.

panel_summary.scope_guard: One preregistered common-task failure-pattern probe only; not a prevalence estimate, model ranking, or causal effect estimate. Opus demonstrates partial evidence-changing repair without full closure; GPT-5-mini and MiniMax are negative controls for overcounting limitations already absorbed by current claim scope.

candidate_updates.name: issue-ledger review-closure invariant
candidate_updates.observation: The preregistered panel yields six explicit load-bearing self-critiques, no full closures, and no durable machine-actionable repair_pending. Opus is a useful partial-repair counterexample: requested evidence-changing experiments were executed, yet the broader issue remained open.
candidate_updates.refinement: Track issue identity rather than a single repaired/not-repaired bit. After every repair, re-evaluate whether that exact issue closed, whether another severe issue remains open, whether all load-bearing claim surfaces were reconciled, and whether unresolved issues survive termination as machine-actionable state. A repair action alone cannot unlock promotion.
candidate_updates.causal_boundary: Repeated preregistered failure-pattern observation, not a matched intervention proving the gate improves science.

candidate_updates.name: project-level lineage graph plus bounded dependency/ownership/evaluation task contracts
candidate_updates.mechanism: Represent candidate contributions as lineage-linked innovation atoms, choose a horizontal/vertical/hybrid portfolio decomposition, then emit bounded task contracts with explicit contribution ownership, objectives, inputs, expected artifacts, evaluation requirements, boundary constraints, dependencies and execution order. Keep the contract executor-independent and reject flat overlapping task lists that lack ownership/dependency semantics.

primary_evidence.result: Project2Task reports 10 project briefs and roughly 30 tasks; manuscript-based portfolio quality is 7.15 versus 4.58 for a brief baseline and 5.31 for a topic-only baseline. Integrating the generated contracts with AutoResearchClaw raises average downstream task accuracy from 0.536 to 0.759.

candidate_updates.causal_boundary: Small 10-brief evaluation with manuscript-based portfolio scoring. The abstract does not isolate graph structure from contract content/decomposition, and it does not establish long-run scientific-discovery success.

candidate_updates.name: localized multi-perspective failure diagnosis routed to targeted repair

primary_evidence.result: SearchAuditor studies 1,243 failed long-horizon search trajectories averaging 73.1 messages and 65.1k tokens. With GPT-5.5, the strongest baseline reaches 26.6% end-to-end pass while SearchAuditor reaches 32.3%, and applying its repairs to failed runs improves recovery.

candidate_updates.causal_boundary: Long-horizon search rather than autonomous science; use only as cross-domain evidence that localized diagnosis plus targeted repair can outperform generic diagnosis, not as proof of scientific-validity improvement.

matched_intervention_search.result: No fully matched science-domain same-model/tools/budget optional-critique versus mandatory evidence-changing repair/claim-downgrade/hard-block experiment was identified in this pass.

next_preregistered_panel.selection_rule: Next lexicographically ordered common task after W4400324640. Directory-level metadata confirmed its presence for all eight models before any W4400415064 trajectory body was opened.
